The following events took place in '''3624 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Czerka Interstellar]] invade [[Voss]] in an attempt to undermine the truce between the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].<ref name="TOR:SotS">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Secrets of the Shrine|Voss}}</ref><ref name="TOR_updates:7.3">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref>
*Members of the [[Hidden Chain]] attack [[Port Nowhere]].<ref name="TOR:RtN" />
*[[Tyrus Brokenblade]] is captured on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR:StC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|Ord Mantell}}</ref>
